headlines.text: 2026 brought us this moment: the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Kevin Knight vs. Darby Allin went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.64 ? a good, competitive contest. This stood as the 140th match in AEW TNT Title history ? a real piece of championship history. In the same building where Knight first beat him, Allin started a brawl before the bell even rang, but Knight nailed him with the title belt behind the referee's back to retain ? closing in on becoming the first man to ten TNT Title defenses.

Back on this day in 2020, it was Eddie Kingston's first night in AEW against Cody, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.99 ? a solid showing. Kingston challenged TNT Champion Cody to a No Disqualification match after a heated confrontation ? a physical, high-stakes title opportunity that showcased Kingston's hard-hitting brawling style against one of the promotion's biggest stars
Back on this day in 2022, it was Ashley D'Amboise's first night in AEW against Britt Baker vs. Jamie Hayter vs. Skye Blue, appearing on Rampage, rated 4.71.

secondaries.text: 2023 brought us this moment: Allin & Punk wasted no time making an impression, debuting right in the main event as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.39 ? a good, competitive contest.

Flash back to 2026, when Divine Dominion vs. Sisters Of Sin went to battle over the AEW Women's World Tag Team Titles in a No DQ match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.24. This stood as the 10th match in AEW Women's World Tag Team Titles history ? a nice marker in that championship's story.
On this day in 2020, The Young Bucks vs. The Butcher and The Blade fought it out in a Falls Count Anywhere match on Dynamite, rated 8.10 ? a real highlight of the night in a physical tag team battle.
